title: Enums
description: Enums used by the seed schemas (CONTRACTS §3.3, Q-CT-6). Each enum carries its full spec value list; enums nothing uses yet land with their first user.

NodeKind.description: SIM-CORE §4. Facilities are UnitKinds, not nodes (Q-GP-21, Q-GP-25).

AltBand.description: AIR only (COMBAT §5.3). Adding a band is a contract and content change.

DamageState.description: Q-CBT-1. Destroyed is a lifecycle event (UnitDestroyed), not a damage state.

LossCause.description: Why a unit was lost when it was not a plain kill, fuel exhaustion or a captured base (CONTRACTS §6, Q-SIM-112, NX-400): BRIDGE_COLLAPSE = on a bridge's road edge near the cut point when the bridge fell. Grows one value at a time, with the code that emits it (rule 6a).

QueueLeaveReason.description: Why an entry left the reserve queue (CONTRACTS §6, NX-371): served a slot, replaced by the commander's own new JOIN, rejected when re-checked at serve time, or idle past slots.queue_idle_min. LEFT (a voluntary leave) joins with its command.

PauseReasonCategory.description: Q-ALN-3. STAFF = a manual pause; TECHNICAL = offline auto-pause; MAINTENANCE = weekly window; CEASEFIRE = owner Ceasefire mode.

StaffPauseSubReason.description: Q-ALN-31. Optional, and only with category STAFF.

CampaignResult.description: Q-GD-7, Q-GP-14. Defeat waits for combat (Q-SIM-62).

JobKind.description: Tasking Board job kinds the code handles (GAMEPLAY §1b, CONTRACTS §3.3). STAGE and CAPTURE are posted by the Threat Director on the Static board only (Q-SIM-81, Q-TD-14). PATROL is the Director's on the Static board (Q-SIM-85) and the coalition board's front-line patrol (Q-SIM-94). INTERCEPT is the Static board's hunt of a coalition scout it tracks (Q-SIM-96). REPAIR_BRIDGE is the coalition board's truck field repair of a down bridge (NX-373 part 2). RESCUE joins with its job (rule 6a).

CommandKind.description: Grows one kind at a time, with each handler (AGENTS.md rule 6a).

RejectReason.description: CONTRACTS §5.3. Grows one value at a time, with the code that emits it (rule 6a).

EventKind.description: Grows one kind at a time, with each producer (rule 6a).
